english.meaning: so, then, in that case; starts a clause that follows from what was just said
english.note: A very common way to open a sentence or take the next turn in a conversation.

exampleSentences.english: Yes. So, listeners, please bear with us and listen to this song first.
exampleSentences.traditional: 係。噉就即係唯有即係辛苦各位聽眾呢，聽埋哩隻歌先。
